description:
Add background music to the project from the audio library (find track
    ids with browse_audio_library, category="music"). Defaults loop the track
    under the whole video at bed level (volume 0.12 ≈ -18.4 dB under narration —
    don't raise it without being asked); re-run export_video to hear it.

library_track_id.description: Audio library track ID, from browse_audio_library(category="music")
library_track_id.title: Library Track Id

loop.description: True loops the track under the whole video; false plays it once
loop.title: Loop

name.description: Display name for the track on the project's timeline
name.title: Name

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

start_frame.description: Timeline frame at which the track starts (0 = start of the video)
start_frame.title: Start Frame

volume.description: Playback volume 0-1; the 0.12 default sits at bed level under narration — don't raise it unless asked
volume.title: Volume

name: add_music_track
title: Add music track
